text:
All 10 tests pass. Three surgical fixes in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — replaced `list(set(items))` with a `seen`-set loop that appends in first-encounter order, preserving input order.
2. **`partition`** — returned `yes, no` instead of the swapped `no, yes`, so matches come first.
3. **`windows`** — changed the range bound from `len(items) - k` to `len(items) - k + 1` so the final window is included.

The `run_tests.py` helper I added is just a test runner; `tests/` was left untouched.
